metadata.description: One marketing campaign suite: campaign planning, copywriting, analytics and UTM operations, with campaign images and campaign video production working inside the same campaign workspace

plugins.name: marketing-creative
plugins.description: Thirteen creative skills with a video workflow entry point, beat planning, narration finishing, images and opt-in Veo/Omni clips

plugins.name: marketing-images
plugins.description: Campaign image concepts in one cropped contact sheet, then selected Nano Banana finals individually or through the discounted Gemini Batch API

plugins.name: marketing-performance
plugins.description: The campaign workspace the creative plugins work in: marketing briefs, channel-ready copy, Google Analytics 4 funnel analysis and campaign operations with documented UTM links and performance reports

plugins.name: video-studio
plugins.description: Campaign explainers and cinematic short films: direction from the brief, native English or Indonesian scripts, ElevenLabs narration and sound, continuity bibles, contact-sheet boards, approved Higgsfield or Gemini API takes with dailies, HyperFrames compositions, assembly, QC and handoff into the campaign's approved assets
